title: Approve Admin UX ADR bundle
objective: Resolve the 10 architecture decisions before broad page migration.
implementation: Review and approve the IA, URL/scope, workspace ownership, component convergence, data-state, collection, workspace-navigation, critical-action, Dashboard and mobile-scope ADR drafts. Record decisions and explicitly mark deferred scope.
acceptance: All ADRs have a Decided/Deferred status; no downstream phase depends on an unresolved decision; every deferred item has a rationale and launch impact.
tests: Document review + architecture sign-off.

title: Create seeded UX regression fixtures
objective: Make premiere-quality behavior testable before UI migrations begin.
implementation: Define deterministic Organization A/B fixtures, 120+ events/tours, unread messages, failed/degraded API fixtures, finance/ticketing data, mobile viewport scenarios and representative role/capability personas.
acceptance: Fixtures can reproduce every critical collection-scale, multi-org, failure-truthfulness and mobile scenario referenced by this plan.
tests: Fixture smoke run; seed idempotency test.

title: Restructure first-level Admin IA
objective: Replace feature-inventory navigation with a task-oriented Admin hierarchy.
implementation: Define canonical first-level groups, map every current route to the new taxonomy, keep old routes as deep-link aliases, redesign sidebar search to return direct matches, and add a recent/pinned area only after the primary hierarchy is simplified.
acceptance: Every current Admin destination remains reachable; first-click testing improves for common owner/manager/coordinator tasks; no duplicate primary label represents the same concept; search returns direct matching destinations.
tests: Route inventory test; first-click usability test; keyboard search test.

title: Replace custom mobile/collapsed sidebar behavior
objective: Make Admin navigation accessible, SPA-native and compact on constrained viewports.
implementation: Move mobile navigation to the canonical Sheet/Drawer primitive, add focus trap/restore/Escape/scroll lock, ensure every icon-only nav item has an accessible label + tooltip, remove window.location navigation, and collapse stable acting-context chrome.
acceptance: One accessible mobile drawer; no internal full reloads; collapsed items have accessible names; body does not scroll behind drawer; stable scope consumes less vertical height.
tests: axe; VoiceOver/TalkBack; keyboard Escape/focus; navigation no-reload assertion.

title: Unify acting-organization scope control
objective: Put the active organization and the action to change it in one predictable place.
implementation: Merge the scope indicator and switch affordance into the canonical Admin header/context control. Preserve the existing acting-context security model; do not silently switch scope from child URLs.
acceptance: Users can identify and switch the organization from any Admin workspace; every mutation still carries the resolved acting context; scope change is visually confirmed before page data mutates.
tests: Two-org deep-link test; stale-scope mutation negative test.

title: Implement canonical Admin URL/scope contract
objective: Give all Admin workspaces the same rules for account scope, child scope, tab/view, filters, pagination and selected records.
implementation: Create shared parse/build/update helpers; define canonical keys; preserve supported legacy aliases; ensure internal links preserve account/scope context; define collection→detail return-state behavior.
current_target_files: multiple inspected Admin route files; multiple inspected files
acceptance: Back/Forward/refresh/share work consistently across representative workspaces; legacy links resolve to canonical state; account scope is never silently changed by a child URL.
tests: Automated URL matrix; browser history tests; cross-org tamper tests.

title: Migrate Dashboard navigation state
objective: Make Dashboard refresh and drill-down preserve the working view.
implementation: Replace document reloads with scoped refetch/router navigation and sync active Dashboard tab to URL.
acceptance: No full reload for Refresh/row drill-down; copied URL restores the active Dashboard subview; Back returns to the same working state.
tests: Playwright history/deep-link test.

title: Migrate Tour portfolio view/filter state
objective: Make Tour portfolio searches, filters and saved-view selections shareable and restorable.
implementation: Encode search/status/tag/owner/saved-view/sort/page/density in the canonical collection URL contract.
acceptance: Two sessions opening the same URL see the same working set; Back/Forward restores changes.
tests: Portfolio deep-link test; saved-view regression.

title: Normalize Event edit routes
objective: Use one canonical Event edit URL regardless of entry point.
implementation: Choose the canonical edit route, migrate cards/detail/related links, and keep legacy id/draft aliases redirecting without losing account/scope.
acceptance: Every edit entry point lands on the same canonical URL and opens the same Event.
tests: Link inventory + redirect test.

title: Harden Calendar scope resolution and option loading
objective: Make global Calendar scope explicit, organization-safe and failure-transparent.
implementation: Add an explicit organization/all scope when backend support exists; otherwise clearly label narrowing. Fetch Tour/Event options with acting-context headers and render scope-option unavailable/retry states instead of empty arrays.
acceptance: Calendar never looks organization-global when narrowed; Org A/B options never cross; option API failure never looks like 'no events'.
tests: Two-org test; failed-option test; scope deep-link test.

title: Normalize Staff/Hiring employer scope and Hiring tab URLs
objective: Give Staff and Hiring the same employer-scope and tab-restoration behavior.
implementation: Use one scope-loading/remediation path across Staff tabs; make Hiring tabs controlled by URL like Staff.
acceptance: No tab-specific missing-scope surprises; Hiring tab survives refresh/share/back.
tests: Employer hydration tests; Hiring deep-link tests.

title: Migrate Ticketing, Finance, Contracts, Communications and Analytics URL state
finding_ids: AUX-TIX-002, AUX-TIX-006, AUX-FIN-002, AUX-CON-001, AUX-COM-005, AUX-ANL-004
objective: Complete URL-state parity across the remaining high-value Admin workspaces.
implementation: Sync active tab/view and relevant event/date/conversation scope using the canonical helpers; preserve account context on all replacements.
acceptance: Each workspace restores exact meaningful state after refresh/share/back; selected Event/conversation/date scope remains visible.
tests: Parameterized deep-link test matrix.

title: Publish canonical workspace ownership matrix
objective: Remove ambiguity between embedded Event/Tour panels and global workspaces.
implementation: For each domain (Tasks, Workforce, Hiring, Logistics, Comms, Ticketing, Finance, Vendors/Contracts, Calendar) name the canonical UI, embedded-mode contract, allowed mutation ownership and return-path convention.
acceptance: Every duplicated domain has one documented source-of-truth UI and an approved embed/deep-link approach.
tests: Architecture review + route/component crosswalk.

title: Build canonical Admin header/scope variants
objective: Standardize collection, record, workspace and settings headers.
implementation: Extend or replace AdminPageHeader with variants supporting breadcrumbs/back, scope, status, save/dirty state, primary/secondary/overflow actions and responsive behavior.
acceptance: All migrated pages preserve page identity and one primary action from 320px through desktop; record state/scope are visible when relevant.
tests: Story/fixture coverage; axe; responsive screenshot tests.

title: Implement universal Admin data-state contract
objective: Eliminate false-empty and false-zero behavior across Admin.
implementation: Define typed state/result helpers for loading, ready, true-empty, filtered-empty, stale, degraded, denied and unavailable. Add canonical panel/page/metric renderers, retry behavior and one freshness vocabulary.
acceptance: No migrated P1 surface maps failed primary data to legitimate 0/empty; stale/partial data is visibly labeled; action errors do not replace healthy page state.
tests: Fault-injection component tests; API-state fixture tests; screenshot assertions.

title: Create reusable AttentionQueue primitive
objective: Provide one reusable model for actionable exceptions and direct remediation.
implementation: Support severity, count, scope, owner, due time, source domain, direct internal Link navigation and View All; preserve context.
acceptance: More than three issues remain discoverable; internal issue navigation stays SPA-native; Dashboard can aggregate domain queues.
tests: Seeded attention fixture; link/navigation test.

title: Fix nested landmarks and viewport sizing
objective: Make every Admin route use one main landmark and predictable scroll ownership.
implementation: Refactor WorkforcePageShell into a nested section/container variant; remove second min-h-screen; establish min-h-0/flex scroll contracts for split-pane workspaces.
acceptance: Exactly one main landmark; no double-scroll on target viewports; keyboard scrolling remains predictable.
tests: axe landmark test; 768px-height + mobile Safari scroll test.

title: Converge Admin/Workforce/scheduling primitives
objective: Stop visual/interaction drift between Admin domains.
implementation: Create keep/merge/deprecate matrix for headers/heroes, panels, metrics, empty states, Button/Input/Sheet/toasts and spacing. Migrate high-value consumers to shared primitives before deleting legacy variants.
acceptance: No new duplicate primitive family; migrated pages use the same focus/error/loading/action semantics; contracts page no longer double-pads.
tests: Component inventory; visual regression; a11y tests.

title: Build structural Admin skeleton variants
objective: Replace generic spinners/text placeholders with stable structural loading states.
implementation: Create collection, record/workspace, table and split-pane skeletons and migrate Calendar/Ticketing/Hiring/command panels.
acceptance: Loading preserves major geometry and avoids obvious layout jumps.
tests: Throttled visual regression.

title: Define domain-controller decomposition pattern
objective: Provide a consistent way to split oversized client orchestrators without rewriting domain logic.
implementation: Document controller/panel boundaries, active-tab data activation, shared record context and isolated error-state ownership; apply first to Event/Tour migrations.
acceptance: Event/Tour/Logistics/Comms refactors follow the same boundary rules and unrelated panel failures stay isolated.
tests: Architecture review + profiler baseline.

title: Build shared lifecycle/critical-action pattern
objective: Make publish/cancel/archive/delete/refund/settlement transitions predictable and consequence-aware.
implementation: Create CriticalActionDialog/LifecycleAction components with target scope, allowed transition, readiness/blockers, consequence preview, required confirmation, audit metadata and success/undo guidance when available.
acceptance: High-impact mutations never occur from an unexplained generic select/button; blocked transitions explain why.
tests: Lifecycle transition tests; keyboard/focus tests.

title: Standardize touch, icon-action and reduced-motion behavior
objective: Make compact Admin controls usable and understandable across touch and assistive technology.
implementation: Add IconActionButton/Tooltip contract, responsive touch-size variants and reduced-motion utilities; migrate cards, Staff tabs and Inbox micro-actions.
acceptance: Icon-only controls have accessible names/tooltips; critical mobile controls meet comfortable target sizes; Reduce Motion disables decorative movement.
tests: axe; touch-target scan; prefers-reduced-motion test.

title: Create canonical responsive AdminDataTable
objective: Provide one table/list behavior for dense Admin data on desktop and mobile.
implementation: Support column priority, sticky key/action columns, compact mobile row cards/detail, sorting, filters, pagination and accessible overflow cues.
acceptance: Representative order/finance tables remain operable at 375px without hidden critical actions.
tests: Responsive table fixture tests; keyboard/table semantics.

title: Replace Tour saved-view prompt and unify collection toolbar
objective: Make Tour saved views and collection controls production-grade.
implementation: Add in-product save-view dialog with personal/org ownership, default/duplicate handling; expose View all drafts; separate view controls, filters/sort and selection-only bulk actions.
acceptance: No browser prompt; all drafts discoverable; view state is understandable and shareable.
tests: Saved-view permission/duplicate tests; toolbar task test.

title: Add Tour pagination, compact mode and authoritative KPIs
objective: Make Tour portfolio accurate and usable beyond 100 records.
implementation: Introduce server paging/infinite loading, compact/table density, server-scope KPI summary, unavailable metric states and one-primary-action card behavior.
acceptance: 115th tour is discoverable; KPIs match authoritative totals; failed logistics metrics never render as 0%; card actions are accessible.
tests: >120 record tests; KPI parity; fault injection; mobile card/table tests.

title: Add Event pagination, compact mode and trustworthy cards
objective: Make Event portfolio scalable, dense and truthful.
implementation: Add server paging/compact view, unavailable logistics state, accessible card action hierarchy and safe date handling.
acceptance: 115th event is discoverable; invalid dates never leak; failed metrics are not zeros; mobile actions remain clear.
tests: >120 record tests; invalid-date fixture; fault injection; accessibility.

title: Fix Event attention/export/draft workflows
objective: Make collection-level exception and support actions behave as labeled.
implementation: Needs Attention opens a real attention filter/queue; export failure stays action-scoped; draft recovery exposes full draft set.
acceptance: Attention result set is correct; failed export leaves collection healthy; all drafts are reachable.
tests: Attention filter test; export fault test; >3 drafts.

title: Consolidate Ticketing order tables and authoritative export
objective: Turn Ticketing transactions into a real searchable order ledger.
implementation: Replace duplicate All/Completed/Refunded tables with one server-paged AdminDataTable, status views and scoped server export.
acceptance: 30th+ order is searchable; refund view uses same row/action model; CSV includes complete scoped data and escapes fields correctly.
tests: Order search/paging/refund/export tests.

title: Build canonical Finance ledger and authoritative export/time series
objective: Replace recent-card finance browsing with a complete ledger/reporting surface.
implementation: Use server-paged finance table, authoritative server export and aggregate time-series endpoint rather than recentTransactions-derived charts.
acceptance: 200-record ledger is searchable; export/time series match authoritative scope/date data.
tests: Paging/search; CSV escaping/completeness; time-series parity.

title: Publish KPI coverage/source-of-truth matrix
objective: Make every Admin metric explicit about scope, coverage and freshness.
implementation: Inventory Dashboard/Tours/Events/Logistics/Ticketing/Finance/Analytics KPIs, identify authoritative summary endpoints, remove client-page aggregates from organization-total labels, and attach freshness/coverage semantics.
acceptance: No organization-level KPI is computed from a paged visible subset unless explicitly labeled; chart coverage is documented/tested.
tests: Seed beyond page limits; compare API summaries to DB fixtures.

title: Rebuild Dashboard information hierarchy
objective: Make Dashboard answer 'what needs attention?' and 'what should I do next?' immediately.
implementation: Use canonical header, place Action/Attention queue first, then today's next actions, compact KPIs and secondary insights; remove repeated widgets across tabs.
acceptance: 5-second test reliably identifies urgent work and next action; no repeated global widget blocks.
tests: Usability test; visual regression.

title: Unify Dashboard live/freshness status
objective: Prevent stale Dashboard data from looking live.
implementation: Replace independent green 'Live Updates' cue/status widgets with the canonical freshness state tied to actual subscription/refetch health.
acceptance: Disconnecting realtime visibly changes status; last successful update remains available.
tests: Realtime disconnect/reconnect fixture.

title: Fix task and mini-calendar interactions
objective: Make Dashboard task/calendar affordances truthful and directly actionable.
implementation: Gate tasks on acting context; distinguish unavailable vs empty; route View All to canonical Task/Action center; make calendar dates open canonical day view or remove fake affordance; use recognizable mini-month/timeline with accessible event counts.
acceptance: Task API failure never shows all-clear; View All reaches all task domains; every pointer-styled date works; calendar meaning is available without color/hover.
tests: Fault injection; pointer/keyboard tests; mobile calendar test.

title: Build hierarchical Admin workspace navigation
objective: Replace 7–16 peer tabs with a reusable primary/secondary workspace hierarchy.
implementation: Create responsive workspace navigation supporting primary domains, secondary subviews, More/overflow, counts/attention badges, keyboard navigation and canonical URL state. Preserve existing deep links through mapping.
acceptance: Event/Organization/Ticketing workspaces no longer render massive tab walls on mobile; all legacy tab URLs resolve to the correct new location.
tests: Keyboard/tab semantics; 375px first-click tests; deep-link alias matrix.

title: Refactor Tour record shell and task hierarchy
objective: Keep Tour's strong lazy-domain contracts while reducing record-page complexity.
implementation: Move record identity/status/actions into shared record shell; split domain controllers; group Shows/People/Partners/Money/Operations/Calendar according to approved IA while keeping deferred bundle contracts.
acceptance: Overview loads without unnecessary editor bundles; domain failure is isolated; common tasks need fewer first-level choices.
tests: Bundle/network profile; domain failure tests; first-click study.

title: Refactor Event record shell and top-level hierarchy
objective: Turn the 13-tab Event mega-page into a focused record command center.
implementation: Create shared event record shell, split domain controllers, map current 13 tabs into approved primary/secondary groups and preserve every deep link.
acceptance: Mobile navigation is compact; active domain data loads independently; no event identity/status/action duplication.
tests: Network/effect profile; deep-link matrix; mobile first-click tests.

title: Make Event child-domain failure states explicit
objective: Stop Event detail from silently translating domain failures into empty content.
implementation: Use record skeleton/not-found/denied variants and per-panel result handling for tasks, staff, vendors, finance, notifications and analytics; check response.ok before parsing; keep sibling panels healthy.
acceptance: 403/500 in one child domain never makes it look empty and never blocks unrelated domains.
tests: Fault-injection matrix; 404/403; visual state snapshots.

title: Improve Event duplicate and coordinator action semantics
objective: Make Event actions accurately predict and preview what happens.
implementation: Add duplicate preview preserving duration and copy/reset scope; rename navigation-only actions to Open/View or directly open the create flow; prioritize 3–5 next-best actions.
acceptance: Duplicate retains intended duration; labels match outcome; coordinator action panel no longer acts as a feature list.
tests: Duplicate fixtures; click-outcome audit.

title: Turn Event People/Logistics into scoped canonical workspaces
objective: Remove multi-workspace scrolling and ambiguous logistics ownership inside Event.
implementation: Use secondary People navigation for Schedule/Roster/Jobs/Participants. Mount or deep-link the canonical Logistics workspace in event-scoped mode with stable breadcrumbs/return path.
acceptance: Create shift/review roster/post job require a focused subview; editing logistics from Event/global reaches the same model and returns predictably.
tests: Cross-entry mutation test; mobile task test.

title: Refine Staff mobile navigation and scheduling hierarchy
objective: Make Staff Operations clear on mobile and exception-driven on desktop.
implementation: Keep accessible tab labels, make Scheduler the primary scheduling workspace, surface conflict/attendance/uncovered counts as badges/drawers, and retain direct Create Shift/Message Teams actions.
acceptance: Mobile tabs are named; creating a shift does not require scrolling through exception panels; conflicts/uncovered work are visible before opening subviews.
tests: Mobile a11y; scheduling task test.

title: Rebuild Hiring page identity and funnel hierarchy
objective: Make Hiring read as a focused funnel instead of a generic tab strip.
implementation: Add canonical employer-scoped header/Create Job action; prioritize Jobs→Applications→Onboarding→Roster; move Templates/Audit to secondary administration; make healthy SLO compact and degraded SLO prominent.
acceptance: Deep-link user can identify employer and primary task immediately; low-frequency administration does not compete with funnel work.
tests: First-click study; healthy/degraded visual tests.

title: Reorganize Organization's 16-tab governance surface
finding_ids: AUX-ORG-001, AUX-ORG-002, AUX-ORG-003, AUX-ORG-004, AUX-ORG-005, AUX-ORG-006
objective: Separate organization governance/configuration from operational workspaces.
implementation: Group Profile/Team, Access/Security, Operational Defaults, Commerce, Data/Compliance/System into secondary nav; distinguish configure vs operate; normalize unauthorized deep links; replace silent disabled tabs with locked/help or hidden states; fix no-org remediation.
acceptance: Owner/admin common tasks have clear first clicks; lower-permission users understand locked capability; no-org CTA solves scope; direct restricted URLs normalize safely.
tests: Persona capability matrix; deep-link tests; first-click study.

title: Clarify Logistics taxonomy and lazy data contracts
objective: Make Logistics terminology predictable and reduce initial request fanout.
implementation: Adopt approved Transport/Travel/Lodging/Equipment/Backline/Catering/Comms/Site hierarchy; define per-tab summary hydration and on-activate endpoints similar to Tour command-center contracts.
acceptance: Overview no longer fetches full data for unused domains; first-click task mapping matches live-event terminology.
tests: Network profile; first-click test.

title: Make Logistics scope and metrics truthful/actionable
objective: Turn Logistics Overview into a scope-safe exception command center.
implementation: Use canonical hierarchical scope breadcrumb; attach state/freshness to each metric; prioritize blockers/next movements and compact domain health; remove false Not Started/No Bookings on failed data.
acceptance: Operator can identify exact org→tour→event→leg scope; failed source never renders valid zero/not-started; next movement is obvious.
tests: Multi-scope test; fault injection; 5-second test.

title: Consolidate duplicate Transport/Travel/Comms/Event logistics surfaces
finding_ids: AUX-LOG-005, AUX-LOG-007, AUX-LOG-008, AUX-LOG-009, AUX-LOG-010, AUX-LOG-012
objective: Eliminate parallel domain editors and long stacked travel/comms pages.
implementation: Choose canonical transport editor, split Travel/Lodging or create focused subviews, define Message/Broadcast/Logistics-note taxonomy, rename/aggregate timeline accurately, and expose degraded event-owner/thread metadata when capabilities depend on it.
acceptance: One clear editor per entity class; Travel tasks stay focused; communications concepts are distinguishable; timeline title matches content.
tests: Cross-editor parity test; travel/comms first-click tests; metadata-failure test.

title: Implement responsive unread-first Inbox
objective: Make the unified inbox a real desktop/mobile operational communication tool.
implementation: Desktop split-pane with flexible height; mobile list→conversation navigation; render unread counts/weight and filters; add inbox search/sections; update non-selected conversation metadata in realtime or expose freshness.
acceptance: 30-conversation mobile flow remains usable; unread work is visible without opening threads; new message elsewhere updates inbox metadata.
tests: Mobile viewport tests; realtime unread test; keyboard scroll.

title: Upgrade voice-note and attachment trust UX
objective: Make message attachments/voice notes reviewable, accessible and private by default.
implementation: Add recording duration/cancel/preview/remove/upload progress; enlarge accessible pending-file remove controls; move operational attachments to private authorized/signed retrieval according to security plan.
acceptance: Voice note can be canceled/reviewed before send; touch controls are usable; unauthenticated attachment access is rejected.
tests: Microphone-denied/cancel/preview tests; unauthenticated attachment negative test.

title: Reorganize Ticketing and lazy-load domain data
objective: Replace the 12-tab ticketing feature inventory with a workflow-oriented workspace.
implementation: Group Setup/Inventory, Sales/Orders, Admissions/Guests, Marketing and Reporting/Settings; load summary first and domain data on activation; move read-model/ledger diagnostics into relevant subviews; require concrete verified Event metadata for sharing.
acceptance: Initial request fanout drops; child failure is explicit; first-click ticketing tasks improve; All Events cannot generate synthetic event sharing.
tests: Network profile; child failure matrix; ticketing first-click tests.

title: Make Finance truthful and task-oriented
objective: Make Finance clearly distinguish authoritative data, exceptions and canonical budget/settlement workflows.
implementation: Never render zero KPI after failed primary load; prioritize reconciliation/next actions; consolidate legacy budget cards/dialog into versioned workspace after parity; show human-readable settlement identity.
acceptance: Finance failure is visibly unavailable/stale; one budget flow remains; settlement can be identified by event/tour name/date.
tests: Finance fault injection; budget parity; settlement lookup test.

title: Clarify Vendor Master/Contract ownership and naming
objective: Make vendor identity, assignment, contract and governance boundaries understandable.
implementation: Choose canonical parent label/route alias; define Vendor Master as identity/compliance source, Event/Tour vendor panels as scoped assignments, Contracts as legal/commercial records and Organization tab as governance/defaults.
acceptance: Add vendor→assign→contract→obligation flow is understandable and uses one vendor identity.
tests: Cross-surface journey test; route label test.

title: Fix Analytics failure, export and realtime scope
objective: Make analytics trustworthy enough for management decisions.
implementation: Replace EMPTY_STATS-on-failure with unavailable/stale states; pass acting context to export; surface export failures; explicitly scope realtime activity to active organization and show freshness; suppress invalid derived visuals when primary stats are unavailable.
acceptance: Stats failure never looks zero; Org A export/live feed never leaks Org B; export errors are actionable.
tests: Two-org realtime/export tests; primary stats fault injection.

title: Run and close cross-surface mobile/a11y migration
objective: Close remaining cross-surface responsive accessibility gaps after shared primitives land.
implementation: Audit every migrated major workspace at 320/375/390/768 widths, 200% zoom, keyboard-only and screen-reader. Fix remaining table overflow, focus order, touch targets, action overflow and scroll ownership.
acceptance: No critical/serious axe violations in target routes; all launch-critical workflows are keyboard and mobile operable; responsive tables preserve key identity/actions.
tests: axe; screen-reader scripts; Playwright viewport suite.

title: Execute authenticated cross-persona UX journeys
dependencies: ADMUX-0302, ADMUX-0303, ADMUX-0403, ADMUX-0506, ADMUX-0603, ADMUX-0705, ADMUX-0802, ADMUX-0901, ADMUX-1001
objective: Prove that the redesigned Admin works across real account/persona boundaries.
implementation: Run deterministic Admin→Worker, Admin→Artist, vendor/contract, ticket refund→finance, communications, multi-org scope and mobile journeys. Capture URL/scope transitions, feedback, failure recovery and accessibility evidence.
acceptance: Every launch-critical persona journey passes with no ambiguous scope, false-empty state, broken Back behavior or inaccessible control.
tests: Full runtime UX scenario suite; video/screenshots/network logs.

title: Feature-flag and migrate high-risk UX architecture
objective: Roll out navigation/workspace changes without stranding deep links or active organizations.
implementation: Use route aliases and feature flags for IA/workspace migrations, add analytics for old/new route use, stage rollout by internal/test organizations, and remove legacy UI only after parity + usage verification.
acceptance: Legacy bookmarked URLs still work during migration; rollback can restore prior workspace; no data-model destructive migration is required solely for UI changes.
tests: Flag off/on smoke; alias tests; rollback drill.
